name: muster
description: Muster is a self-hosted back office for projects, clients, invoices, knowledge, assets, and delivery records, wired into Claude Code. Agents read and update the same records people use, over MCP.

directus_url.title: Board URL
directus_url.description: Directus base URL of your board, e.g. https://your-board.example.com. Required.

directus_token.title: Board API token
directus_token.description: Directus static token for your board. Stored in your OS keychain. Required. The first MCP tool call still asks you to approve it.
